comment_regular: Verified active-effect list save layout: TESSaveLoadGame_UseSaveGameBlocks controls whether the list emits a BLOK header and reserves/backpatches a block size. The list always reserves and patches a UInt16 effect count. Per-effect records separately use the save version threshold 0x2A to include a UInt16 record-size field.
